summary: Two attempts per view, including exactly one corrective regeneration. Final named files contain the selected unmodified raw returns. Neither view meets all acceptance checks; no resizing, alpha replacement, recolouring, external image API, build or runtime integration was performed.

runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: unlit albedo texture-projection source for an existing 3D game decoration.
Edit only the first input image, the grey orthographic guide. The second image (design_reference.png) is the approved material and colour reference, not a geometry or camera reference. The third (concept_crop.png) is the original concept.
OUTPUT: exactly 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuine transparent background. Preserve the guide canvas, scale, position, silhouette and its alpha boundary exactly, pixel for pixel. Keep every shape edge, opening, notch and surface division at precisely the guide coordinates. Nothing added outside the guide silhouette; nothing cropped, enlarged, recentered, rotated or redesigned. Preserve transparent holes as transparent holes.
Paint only the existing guide surfaces with the design's black-violet resin and chitin, saturated glowing-orange slit-window surfaces and ivory bone thorns. Keep the material identity of wet glossy resin through its black-purple pigmentation and organic fine texture, but do NOT bake glossy lighting into this albedo image. Use the existing guide's surface edges to place those materials. Do not copy the reference's different silhouette, three-quarter view, studio lighting, background or halo.
LIGHTING: even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. Albedo/base-colour only. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional gradients, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no white gleams, no rim light, no background, no floor. Orange sacs and seams have their saturated glowing colour without bloom, halo or light spill on any neighbouring surface. No text or labels.
VIEW: exact orthographic FRONT from guide_front.png. The tall narrow spire occupies x=345..678 and y=66..957 on the 1024-square canvas. Keep the thin pointed apex, asymmetrical side thorns, winding diagonal ridges, interior openings, and flared root base exactly as drawn in this guide. The peak and existing thorn caps are warm ivory bone; the remaining structure is black-violet chitin/resin with orange slit-window colour only on existing inset surfaces. Preserve the narrow transparent opening near the middle left. Do not replace this front view with the design reference's three-quarter view.
runs.reason: Not selected: first return is 1254x1254 instead of 1024x1024, includes stray alpha outside the guide and pronounced baked-in highlights and crevice shading. Superseded by the sole corrective attempt, retained for the generation record.

checks.materials_and_colours: Visual check: black-violet resin/chitin, orange slit-window pigment and ivory bone match the reference palette.
checks.flat_even_light_reason: Bright resin edge highlights and dark crevice shading are baked into the colour.
checks.transparent_background: RGBA with genuine fully transparent pixels, but nonzero alpha extends outside the intended silhouette.
checks.internal_shape_edges: Not verified as identical; generated detail and material boundaries deviate from the immutable guide.
checks.silhouette_reason: Exact comparison fails: the returned canvas is 1254x1254 while the guide is 1024x1024. Nonzero alpha also extends far beyond the visible object.
